scope: Full local audit of every successfully parsed Embodied AI paper in paper-digest-manifest.json; no arXiv download, web lookup, or website/source-data edit.

decisionPolicy.approve: Approve only named data explicitly used for training, fine-tuning, imitation learning, offline RL, alignment, or classifier training, with local evidence of public access or an exact cited dataset publication independently used in the corpus.
decisionPolicy.reject: Reject evaluation/test-only assets, benchmark-only data, environments/task suites, models/methods, private or unreleased constructed data, planned future releases, ambiguous matches, and upstream mentions without enough public-data evidence.
decisionPolicy.linkPolicy: Include URLs only when the exact URL or arXiv identifier occurs in the local paper text/citation; otherwise null. Never infer a repository from a name.
